display.purpose: The verdict sentence on a dataset page.

title.purpose: Dataset names, section headings, the loupe disguise name.

subtitle.purpose: Named blocks in the loupe and beside the verdict.

body.purpose: Sentences, capped at 68ch where they run long.

score.purpose: Scores under frames and scale legends, tabular numerals.

shadows.name: selected-frame
shadows.purpose: Amber outline inside a selected frame.

shadows.name: pressed-choice
shadows.purpose: Doubles the grease border of a selected choice.

shadows.name: running-halo
shadows.purpose: Breathes to 6px around the running status dot.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The main action of a view, in grease with hand-cut corners.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 36px; padding: 6px 14px; border: 1px solid var(--grease); border-radius: 5px 3px 6px 3px / 3px 6px 3px 5px; background: var(--grease); color: #fff; font: 600 15px/1.5 var(--sans); cursor: pointer; transition: background .15s, border-color .15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--grease-dark); border-color: var(--grease-dark); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--grease); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Default Button
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 36px; padding: 6px 14px; border: 1px solid var(--ink-3); border-radius: 3px; background: transparent; color: var(--ink); font: 15px/1.5 var(--sans); cursor: pointer; transition: background .15s, color .15s, border-color .15s; } .ds-btn:hover { background: var(--paper-2); border-color: var(--ink); } .ds-btn:active { background: var(--rule); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--grease); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Destructive actions such as stopping a run.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 36px; padding: 6px 14px; border: 1px solid var(--fail); border-radius: 3px; background: transparent; color: var(--fail); font: 15px/1.5 var(--sans); cursor: pointer; transition: background .15s; } .ds-btn-danger:hover { background: var(--fail-bg); } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--grease); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: A white field with a Pale Ink border that turns grease on focus.
components.css: .ds-field { display: block; font: 15px/1.5 var(--sans); color: var(--ink); } .ds-field > span { display: block; font-weight: 600; margin-bottom: 4px; } .ds-input { min-height: 36px; width: 100%; padding: 6px 10px; border: 1px solid var(--ink-3); border-radius: 3px; background: #fff; font: inherit; color: inherit; } .ds-input:focus { outline: 2px solid var(--grease); outline-offset: 0; border-color: var(--grease); }

components.name: Navigation
components.description: The slim header with an ink underline on the current page.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 18px; font: 15px/1.5 var(--sans); } .ds-nav a { color: var(--ink-2); text-decoration: none; padding: 4px 0; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; } .ds-nav a:hover { color: var(--ink); } .ds-nav a[aria-current=page] { color: var(--ink); border-bottom-color: var(--ink); } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--grease); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Choice
components.description: A selectable white sheet with a bold line and a hint.
components.css: .ds-choice { display: block; max-width: 300px; padding: 10px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--rule); border-radius: 3px; background: #fff; color: var(--ink); font: 15px/1.5 var(--sans); cursor: pointer; text-align: left; transition: border-color .15s; } .ds-choice:hover { border-color: var(--ink); } .ds-choice[aria-pressed=true] { border-color: var(--grease); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--grease); } .ds-choice:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--grease); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-choice b { display: block; } .ds-choice span { display: block; font-size: .85rem; color: var(--ink-2); }

components.name: Status Line
components.description: A dot and a plain sentence; only failure takes color.
components.css: .ds-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; font: .87rem/1.5 var(--sans); color: var(--ink); } .ds-dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; flex: none; background: var(--ink-3); } .ds-running .ds-dot { background: var(--edge); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(82% .13 78 / .3); animation: ds-breathe 2.4s ease-in-out infinite; } @keyframes ds-breathe { 50% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 6px oklch(82% .13 78 / .12); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-running .ds-dot { animation: none; } }

components.name: Film Frame
components.description: The signature frame: film with sprockets, an amber edge number, a grease circle on the pick.
components.html: 1A
components.css: .ds-frame { position: relative; width: 220px; } .ds-film { position: relative; display: block; background: var(--film); padding: 15px 4px; } .ds-film::before, .ds-film::after { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; height: 9px; background-image: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 5px, var(--paper) 5px, var(--paper) 12px, transparent 12px); background-size: 17px 6px; background-repeat: repeat-x; background-position: 0 center; opacity: .92; } .ds-film::before { top: 3px; } .ds-film::after { bottom: 3px; } .ds-img { display: block; width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 4 / 3; background: var(--film-2); } .ds-edge { position: absolute; right: 7px; bottom: 16px; font: 10px/1 var(--mono); color: var(--edge); text-shadow: 0 0 2px #000, 0 0 2px #000; } .ds-mark { position: absolute; inset: 3px -3px; width: calc(100% + 6px); height: calc(100% - 6px); overflow: visible; pointer-events: none; } .ds-mark path { fill: none; stroke: var(--grease); stroke-width: 3.5px; stroke-linecap: round; vector-effect: non-scaling-stroke; }

components.name: Stage Bar
components.description: The pipeline as a cut of film, with the active stage in amber.
components.css: .ds-stages { display: flex; margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; background: var(--film); color: oklch(68% .01 80); font: .8rem/1.25 var(--sans); } .ds-stages li { flex: 1; padding: 9px 10px; border-right: 1px solid var(--film-2); } .ds-stages li:last-child { border-right: 0; } .ds-done { color: oklch(88% .01 80); } .ds-stages .ds-active { background: var(--edge); color: var(--film); font-weight: 600; }

components.name: Score Scale
components.description: Reference ticks, a translucent interval, and a grease tick for this score.
components.css: .ds-scale { position: relative; height: 22px; width: 300px; } .ds-line { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; top: 10px; height: 2px; background: var(--rule); } .ds-span { position: absolute; top: 10px; height: 2px; background: var(--ink-3); } .ds-ci { position: absolute; top: 7px; height: 8px; background: oklch(54% .205 28 / .28); } .ds-scale i { position: absolute; top: 3px; width: 2px; height: 16px; background: var(--ink-3); margin-left: -1px; } .ds-scale i.ds-this { background: var(--grease); width: 4px; margin-left: -2px; top: 1px; height: 20px; }

narrative.overview:
**Creative North Star: "The Editor's Proof Sheet"**

Choosing a disguise works like a photo editor choosing a frame. The interface is cool photo paper with black film laid on it: frames butt together into strips with sprocket holes and amber edge numbers, and a red grease pencil circles the pick. Results are read as a sheet of pictures and plain sentences, with the attacker scores, intervals and checks one step away in the loupe.

Density is that of a working document. Rules and whitespace separate content rather than cards; only the loupe lifts off the paper. Film carries what the machine recorded, paper carries what the tool says about it, and the hand-drawn marks carry the decision. Frames also report progress: they sit undeveloped under a dim safelight while attacks run and develop once those attacks finish.

The refused look is the metric-card ML dashboard. Scores appear as captions under frames and as ticks on a thin scale, never as tiles of large numbers.
keyCharacteristics: Cool paper, black film, and three hand or machine marks: grease red, wax yellow, edge amber.
A single Helvetica-style sans at a compact ramp, with monospace for the machine's literal strings.
Flat by default; the loupe is the one lifted surface.
Tight, square corners, with a slightly uneven cut on the primary button.
Hand-drawn SVG marks with deliberately imperfect paths.
Good news is black ink; bad news gets its own red and extra weight.

rules.name: The Hand and Report Rule
rules.body: Grease is a decision someone marks; Report Red is the system saying something went wrong. A failed frame is crossed out in grease because the sheet is being edited, while its status sentence is in Report Red.

rules.name: The Black Ink Good News Rule
rules.body: Interface chrome has no success color. A passed check, a finished dot and a strong result are all ink, so failure is the only thing that changes color. The drawn scene inside a frame has its own illustration colors, which include greens and are not system tokens.

rules.name: The Silver Heat Rule
rules.body: Density tables shade from paper to dark in one neutral hue (oklch lightness 96% to 28% at .004 chroma, hue 260), switching to white text below 62% lightness. Red stays free to mean the pick.

rules.name: The Machine's Own Words Rule
rules.body: Monospace is for strings the machine wrote verbatim and for film markings: file names, logs, JSON, harness names, column names, frame numbers. Scores people read stay in the sans with tabular numerals. Sentences are never mono.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: The build has no uppercase styling and no tracked-out labels. Headings and labels are sentence case and say what they mean.

rules.name: The One Lifted Sheet Rule
rules.body: Only the loupe casts a shadow into the page. Everything else is flat at rest or shows state through inset lines.

dos: Do let film carry the machine's record: frames, progress, logs, file names and VM identity.
Do keep frames touching horizontally inside a strip, with paper showing only between cut rows.
Do tie frame appearance to real progress: undeveloped while waiting, safelight while attacking, developed when finished.
Do caption every drawn frame or strip as a drawing, not the user's footage, for as long as the harness has no real previews.
Do keep a plain sentence beside every score mark, so nothing depends on reading the scale alone.
Do make every animation honor reduced motion, as the global rule does.
donts: Don't build metric cards or tiles of large numbers; scores are captions and scale marks.
Don't add a success green to interface chrome.
Don't add uppercase tracked labels or kickers above headings. The drawn pick word is a mark for the pick alone, not a pattern for other headings.
Don't add shadows to surfaces other than the loupe, or hard offset shadows anywhere.
Don't spend grease on decoration; every appearance marks a decision, an action, this frame's score, or current focus.
Don't round frames or film; they are cut stock.
